# Vellum

Source: https://github.com/sawcyd/vellum/blob/master/README.md

# Vellum

**Vellum** is a powerful, production-ready DataStore persistence layer for [roblox-ts](https://roblox-ts.com/). It provides a robust, document-based API for managing player data with featured like session locking, automated migrations, state reconciliation, and real-time syncing via [Wispr](https://github.com/rbxts/wispr).

## Features

- **🛡️ Session Locking**: Prevents data corruption from multiple server instances by ensuring only one session owns a document at a time.
- **🔄 Auto-Save Scheduler**: Intelligent priority-based auto-saving that respects DataStore budget limits.
- **🧪 Mocking Support**: Built-in `MockAdapter` for instant, local DataStore simulation in Studio/tests.
- **⚡ Wispr Integration**: Automatic real-time state syncing to clients when using Wispr tokens.
- **🏗️ Migrations & Reconciliation**: Version-based migrations and structural reconciliation against defaults.
- **🪝 Lifecycle Hooks**: `beforeLoad`, `afterLoad`, `beforeSave`, `afterSave`, and more.

## Installation

```bash
npm install @rbxts/vellum
```

## Quick Start

### 1. Define your Profile

```ts
import { Vellum } from "@rbxts/vellum";

interface ProfileData {
	coins: number;
	items: string[];
	settings: {
		volume: number;
	};
}

export const ProfileDef = Vellum.define<ProfileData>({
	namespace: "PlayerData",
	version: 1,
	default: {
		coins: 0,
		items: [],
		settings: {
			volume: 0.5,
		},
	},
	key: (player) => `Player_${player.UserId}`,
});
```

### 2. Load and Use

```ts
// Load data (usually in a PlayerAdded event)
const doc = Vellum.load(ProfileDef, player);

if (doc) {
	// Read data
	const data = doc.read();
	print(`Player has ${data.coins} coins`);

	// Update data (automatically marks dirty and syncs to Wispr)
	doc.update((d) => {
		d.coins += 100;
		d.items.push("Sword");
	});

	// Manual save (optional, scheduler handles this automatically)
	doc.save();
}

// Unload when player leaves
Vellum.unload(ProfileDef, player);
```

## Configuration

### Adapters

By default, Vellum uses `DataStoreAdapter`. You can override this for testing:

```ts
import { Vellum, MockAdapter } from "@rbxts/vellum";

if (RunService.IsStudio()) {
	Vellum.setAdapter(new MockAdapter());
}
```

### Debug Mode

Enable structured logging for troubleshooting:

```ts
Vellum.setDebug(true);
```

## Advanced Usage

### Migrations

Handle schema changes gracefully:

```ts
const ProfileDef = Vellum.define<ProfileData>({
	// ...
	version: 2,
	migrations: {
		2: (oldData: any) => {
			// Convert old data format to new one
			return {
				...oldData,
				newField: "DefaultValue",
			};
		},
	},
});
```

### Hooks

Inject logic into the document lifecycle:

```ts
const ProfileDef = Vellum.define<ProfileData>({
	// ...
	hooks: {
		beforeSave: [
			(data) => {
				print("Saving data...");
			},
		],
		afterLoad: [
			(data) => {
				print("Data loaded successfully!");
			},
		],
	},
});
```
